Hi! I'm Ardeshir Pezeshk. I'm interested in a lot of things. This website (really) digs into some of those topics. Enjoy and please don't hesitate to reach out to me at <mailto:pezeshka@gmail.com>. 

## Background
I work in Data Analytics and specialize in survey design, measurement validation, and program evaluation. Having worked alongside longshoreman in Boston, as a researcher and academic pursuing a Ph.D. in Political Science at the University of Massachusetts - Amherst (ABD), and a public school teacher, I've had a non-traditional career path. However, those differences have enabled me to contribute to outside of a typical 'data' role including leading a B2B product redesign that advanced equity and partner satisfaction, grounding strategic growth initiatives, and program/product evaluation.
